thesis: CDNA is in a strong uptrend (close 81.17 above SMA20 75.4, SMA50 65.2, SMA200 36.1) and is consolidating in an orderly way on fading volume after a guidance-raising Q3 beat, a Medicare coverage tailwind and a Zacks #1 upgrade, and healthcare (XLV) leads the current rotation.
